opening.argument: The presentation gives viewers a concrete path into a token-and-mining scheme: it explains how to send euros from a trading account to an exchange, buy tokens, and submit the purchase order. The speaker states, “Now I want to buy tokens and I will show you how to do this,” then directs the viewer to press the bid control. The description identifies buying OneCoin tokens from a mandatory account as the step for starting mining. The order dialog displays a token quantity, transaction value, masked transaction password field, and place-order control. These are instructions to move euros into the required account and complete a purchase, rather than a warning or analysis of the offer.
